sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: A small epiphytic orchid from Taiwan. The name Haraella retrocalla is still used, but Kew treats it as a synonym of Gastrochilus retrocallus; a recent phylogenomic study supports that placement.

sections.title: Leaves and flowers
sections.text: The stems are very short, about 1.5–2 cm; the fleshy leaves are about 3–8 × 0.8–1.5 cm. Yellow flowers have a red lip; the sepals and petals are about 8–10 mm long.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No food use or species-specific toxicity is documented in the sources consulted.
